atoms.b: Most of our muscles are voluntary, which means we have to ((++think talk)) about moving them. Our ((++brain stomach)) sends a message to the muscle, telling it to contract.

Some muscles are involuntary, like the ((++heart thigh)). This means it contracts and relaxes ((++all_the_time rarely)), even when we don’t think about it. Most of the involuntary muscles are in our ((++organs limbs)).

atoms.b: An involuntary muscle that pumps blood around the body.
Pull on bones to create movement.
Muscles work in teams of ((++two three four)) to create movement.
After you have used a muscle a lot, eating ((++proteins carbohydrates fats)) will help it repair itself.
When a muscle ((++contracts bends pushes)), it creates movement in the body.
Some muscles work without us having to think about it. These are called ((++involuntary voluntary satisfactory)) muscles.
